source_title: New iPad mini preorders are live — where to find the best deals, trade-in offers and freebies with Apple's latest tablet
source_excerpt:
A brand-new iPad Mini is on the way — and preorders have started. If Apple 's latest little tablet is on your shopping list and you're looking for the best place to pick one up, I've gathered together where you can buy one right here, including some of the best preorder deals and trade-in offers.
Announced earlier this week, the eighth-generation iPad mini is a much bigger upgrade than we expected . Headline new features include a sharper, brighter, and more vibrant 8.5-inch OLED Super Retina XDR screen, a powerful A20 Pro chip, improved audio, and IP67 water and dust resistance thanks to the new aluminum design.
All those upgrades do come at a more considerable cost, though, as the iPad mini starts at $699 / £699 / AU$1,099 for the standard WiFi version with 128GB of storage. That's $200 / £200 / AU$300 more than the launch price of the previous iPad mini. There are also 256GB and 512GB versions available if you want more room for files and applications.
With that increase in price, it's more important than ever to find a good deal if you want to preorder the new iPad Mini. Here are the best ones I've found so far from retailers, networks, and mobile operators — and I'll continue adding any new offers when I spot them.
Apple Store: from $699 — or lease from $14.99 a month with Apple Upgrade The Apple Store is naturally one of the first places to check for new iPad Mini preorders. Without any special discounts, the tablet is simply available to buy from $699. However, if you have a device to trade in, you can get a discount of up to $915. You can also make use of the Apple Upgrade service to lease your iPad Mini from as little as $14.99 a month for 36 months.
Amazon: preorder now from $699 Amazon has added the latest mini to its iPad lineup. Unsurprisingly, there are no discounts available on any models at this point, although Apple tech has sometimes been given a small discount at the retailer ahead of launch in the past. I'll keep an eye out for any offers.
Best Buy: from $399 with trade-in — plus free Best Buy gift card Best Buy now has the new iPad Mini available for preorder, and as expected, it's got one of the strongest offers from the big retailers. On top of a discount of up to $300 when you trade in an existing iPad, you also get a $50 Best Buy gift card with your order. Not bad to put towards some accessories, or something from the retailer's upcoming Black Friday sale.
Walmart: iPad mini from $699 Walmart has all versions of the new iPad mini available to preorder, though the high-capacity 512GB Starlight model has already sold out. It's another retailer that doesn't have any deals on the new tablet, although it has offered small discounts of up to $50 on some Apple tech in the past at the preorder phase. We'll have to see if that's repeated ahead of launch.
B&H Photo: preorders live from $699 Specialist electronics retailer B&H Photo has the new iPad mini ready to order before the tablets go out for shipping by November 8. I thought this could be a good place to shop, as there have been small discounts of up to $50 on some models during previous iPad launches at this retailer. However, there's no sign of anything like that right now, so full price it is.
Apple Store: from £699 or £58.25 per month – plus, save up to £840 with trade-in Over in the UK, you can now preorder the new iPad mini at the official Apple Store. The tablet starts at the recommended price of £699, but there is also the option to pay on finance from £58.25 per month at 0% interest if that suits you better and you can keep up with the payments. If you have an existing device you want to trade in, then you can save up to £840, too. That's likely one of the highest trade-in discounts we'll see.
Amazon: listed but unavailable Amazon has a listing page live for the new iPad mini in the UK, but it's currently temporarily unavailable to preorder. It'll be one to keep an eye on, as stock could pop up at any minute. The mega-retailer rarely offers trade-in rebates on many products, so this likely won't be the best place to shop if you have a device to sell for an upgrade.
Currys: preorders live with free Apple subscriptions The new iPad mini is now available at Currys. The devices are full price, as expected, but you do get a handy freebie included with your purchase. Specifically, it's up to two months of Apple Music, Apple Arcade, and Apple Fitness Plus for free. A decent extra to pair with your new tablet for some music or gaming.
Apple Store: preorders live – save up to AU$1,370 with trade-in If you're Down Under, preorders for the new iPad mini are open at the official Apple Store, with a starting price of AU$1,099. Apple AU typically doesn't offer any preorder deals, but if you have an existing device you can trade in, you could save up to AU$1,370 on your new purchase.

James Pickard is a Deals Editor at TechRadar. After many years of scouring the net for the cheapest games and tech for his personal use, he decided to make it his job to share all the best bargains and coupon codes with you. James also has almost a decade of experience covering some of the biggest sales events of the year at Eurogamer and VG247, including Black Friday, Cyber Monday and Amazon Prime Day. When not deals hunting or stacking coupon codes to get the biggest savings, James can be found on the PS5, watching a classic film noir or cheering on the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
